extraction.teacher_style: The teacher provides clear, step-by-step instructions for basic movements. He demonstrates the moves himself and encourages viewers to practice along with music.

The teacher breaks down the basic shoulder and knee movements.
The teacher practices the basic moves with music.
The teacher introduces a variation of the basic move.
The teacher practices the variation with music.
The teacher introduces another variation involving shoulder isolation.
The teacher practices the second variation with music.
The teacher introduces a double-count variation.
The teacher practices the double-count variation with music.
The teacher summarizes the learning process and offers advice.

steps_taught.name: Basic Eskista
steps_taught.description: Up and down shoulder movement combined with knee bends.

steps_taught.name: Side-to-side variation

steps_taught.name: Double-count variation
steps_taught.description: Performing the shoulder and knee movement twice.

what_works: The teacher breaks down the movements into simple, manageable parts.
The teacher demonstrates each move with music, which helps in understanding the rhythm.
what_hinders: The lack of a formal counting scheme might make it difficult for some learners to keep track of the rhythm.
The teacher does not provide different camera angles, which could make it harder to see the movements clearly.
